attempts.cause: The isolated mount received only the Hugging Face snapshot directory; its relative symbolic links pointed to an unmounted blob store, so the public checkpoint files were unreadable.
attempts.resolution: Stage a dereferenced local copy of the same hash-pinned base checkpoint; model and tokenizer SHA-256 values remained unchanged.

attempts.cause: PublicPrefixCache wrapped a Transformers DynamicCache but did not delegate its existing batch_select_indices and batch_repeat_interleave operations.
attempts.resolution: Delegate the two cache batch operations through PublicPrefixCache and add a regression test; the selector rule and all preregistered constants are unchanged.

attempts.cause: The first canonical Alpaca-control attempt encountered a transient CUDA allocation failure while entering the larger Finance condition at the common record batch size of eight.
attempts.resolution: Preserve the common batch size for runtime comparability and retry unchanged after confirming there was no competing CUDA process; the unchanged retry completed.

attempts.cause: The first heavy sanitized bundle set padded position IDs to zero, while the repository contract requires padding to repeat the final valid index.
attempts.resolution: Generate padded positions from the cumulative attention mask, validate both target tensors before sanitization, and create a new correction commitment without rewriting the original evidence.

attempts.cause: A single strict process completed all three matched-base policies but encountered CUDA out-of-memory when it switched to the heavy-target condition.
attempts.resolution: Run matched-base and heavy-target conditions in separate fail-closed processes so CUDA state resets between them; candidate rules, policies, batch size, prompts, and observations remain unchanged.
attempts.stage: transition from matched-base to heavy-target predictions

attempts.cause: The separate strict heavy-target process completed K64 and K256 but exhausted 16 GB of CUDA memory during K512 at record batch size eight.
attempts.resolution: Use record batch size four for all four fresh matched/heavy condition processes, preserve batch size eight for both canonical processes, and require exact matched-base tensor invariance before freeze.

attempts.cause: An exact diagnostic comparison of matched-base strict predictions at record batch sizes eight and four found 34 differing entries in the K64 prediction tensor. All finite confidence values and every K256/K512 prediction, route, selected-K, and candidate tensor were identical.
attempts.resolution: Treat reconstruction batch size as an execution setting that can affect outputs and rerun the entire 24-cell matrix at the common memory-safe record batch size four.

attempts.cause: The first batch-four strict heavy-target attempt encountered a transient CUDA allocation failure during K64 immediately after the canonical control process. After exit the device reported no running process and only 424 MiB used.
attempts.resolution: Preserve the failed attempt, verify the CUDA device was clear, and retry the identical batch-four command; the unchanged retry completed all three policies.
